multifit command line interface

Usage:

multifit [–version] [–copying] [–help] COMMAND [ARGS…]

Options:
-h, --help

Print the help screen for the given command and exit.

--version

Print version number and exit.

--copying

Print copyright notice and exit.

List of commands:
config:

Generate a new config file.

fit:

Fit a set of spectra.

gate:

Run a GUI for gating on coincidence spectra.

plot:

Plot a set of spectra, optionally including a fit result.

See multifit help COMMAND for more information on a specific command.
